versions.subject: Cisco Isovalent - Add first batch of new detections (#3706)
versions.detection:
`cisco_isovalent_process_exec` pod_name!=""
| search NOT `cisco_isovalent_allowed_images`
| stats count 
        min(_time) as firstTime 
        max(_time) as lastTime 
    by pod_image_name pod_namespace pod_name process_name cluster_name
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_isovalent___non_allowlisted_image_use_filter`
versions.spl: sourcetype=cisco:isovalent:processExec pod_name!="" | search NOT pod_image_name IN ("docker.io/library/ubuntu:22.04","docker.io/grafana/grafana:12.0.1", "quay.io/isovalent-dev/tetragon-ci*","quay.io/isovalent/tetragon-ci*","quay.io/isovalent/hubble-export-fluentd*") | stats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by pod_image_name pod_namespace pod_name process_name cluster_name | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(firstTime) | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(lastTime) | MACRO=cisco_isovalent___non_allowlisted_image_use_filter
